1. **Light Rope A from both ends** and **Rope B from one end** at the same time.
2. **When Rope A is completely burned**, exactly **30 minutes** will have passed. At this point, **light the other end of Rope B**.
3. **Rope B will now burn from both ends**, so the remaining portion will burn in **half the time** it would take from a single end. Since 30 minutes remain when you light the second end, it will burn completely in **15 minutes**.

**Total time**: 30 minutes (Rope A) + 15 minutes (Rope B) = **45 minutes**.
